description_en: Migrates an instance from one zone to another
description_zh: 该接口用于将实例从一个可用区迁移到另一个可用区
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx migrate-db-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --switch-mode 0 --db-instance-name pxc-xxx --topology-type 3azones --primary-zone-id cn-zhangjiakou-b --secondary-zone-id cn-beijing-l --tertiary-zone-id cn-beijing-h --vpc-id vpc-0000 --vswitch-id vsw-0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MigrateDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The switchover mode. Valid values:

- 0: immediately switches over.
- 1: switches over within the O&M window
parameters.help_zh:
切换模式。取值：

- 0：立即切换。
- 1：在可运维时间段内切换
parameters.name: switch_mode

parameters.help_en:
The topology type. Valid values:

- **3azones**: three-zone deployment.
- **1azone**: single-zone deployment
parameters.help_zh:
拓扑类型：

- **3azones**：三可用区；
- **1azone**：单可用区
parameters.name: topology_type

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the primary zone for a multi-zone instance. **This parameter is required if you want to create a multi-zone instance.**
parameters.help_zh: 多可用区实例，主可用区的可用区ID。**如果需要创建多可用区实例，该参数必填。**
parameters.name: primary_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The secondary zone ID.
> This parameter cannot be set to the same value as ZoneId
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区ID。
> 本参数和ZoneId属性不能相同
parameters.name: secondary_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID for Three-zone deployment
parameters.name: tertiary_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) where the access endpoint resides
parameters.help_zh: 访问端点所在的专有网络ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is required when you create a DRDS instance of the VPC network type
parameters.help_zh: Vswitch ID, 创建 VPC 网络类型的 DRDS 时必须指定
parameters.name: vswitch_id
